actors.comment: As wrapper-prioritize-derived-resources.json, and also the links to the dataset a document belongs to (void:inDataset), so a publisher's dataset document, which names its query service, is read before the rest of its documents. pim:storage is prioritised as well: documents that state pim:storage <./> before void:inDataset <./> have the storage-root link queued unprioritised by the Solid storage extractor first, after which the prioritised void:inDataset copy is dropped as already queued, delaying the dataset document (and its query service) by ~10 s.
